headline: Reagan in 1982: America is 'staggering under a *trillion-dollar debt*'
title: Reagan warned about a $1 trillion US debt in 1982
caption: October 1982: federal debt had just passed $1 trillion, and interest cost $110 billion a year. Today's figures are at the end (FRED data).
context: Today: *${fred:GFDEBTN:1e6:1} trillion* of debt and *${fred:A091RC1Q027SBEA:1e3:2} trillion* a year in interest.
comment: Should the US pay down its debt? 👇
